copy.intro: External playlists enter as sources. The archive stays clean: review a track before it becomes part of the record.
copy.privacy: QQ Music public playlist links can be imported without signing in. The archive stores only the source link, public metadata and your review decisions in this browser.
copy.pasteGuide: QQ Music: paste a public share card and preview automatically. Manual fallback: one track per line as Title — Artist — Album. Album is optional.
copy.empty: No tracks are waiting for review.
copy.libraryEmpty: Nothing has been kept in your personal library yet.
copy.adapterNote: QQ Music public playlists are fetched through this site's server only. No login, Cookie, audio or lyric requests are used. NetEase remains a manual-track import until its public adapter is added.
